name: PyPI install-time credential exfiltration
description: Worked example of an effective dependency_fetch mutant on the git target. Models a compromised Python package executing malicious setup.py logic during installation to exfiltrate sensitive data or credentials to an attacker-controlled mock endpoint. This operator carries an effect block so the validator can classify the mutant as 'effective' (not merely build_valid).

placeholders.SETUP_FILE: relative path to the package's setup.py file
placeholders.ANCHOR_LINE: existing installation-time execution point used as the insertion point

preconditions: project installs a Python package whose installation process executes setup.py
the package source or distribution can be replaced or modified by an attacker
sensitive environment variables or data are accessible during the installation process
